biography: Daniel Devitte, a name whispered with respect in the Opala Old Stock Race paddock, hails from the sun-drenched favelas of São Paulo. Unlike many of his contemporaries who grew up karting on manicured circuits, Daniel honed his skills navigating the chaotic, unforgiving streets of his neighborhood in a beat-up go-kart his father, a former mechanic, cobbled together from spare parts. This raw, visceral experience instilled in him a unique understanding of vehicle dynamics and a fearlessness that sets him apart. His breakthrough came at the Interlagos Old Stock Festival in 2021, where he battled wheel-to-wheel with seasoned veterans, ultimately clinching a podium finish. That race, a blur of screeching tires and the roar of the crowd, cemented his place as a rising star. Currently, Daniel is diligently working his way up the ranks, meticulously studying data and refining his technique, with his sights firmly set on championship glory.
drivingStyle: Devitte's driving style is a fascinating blend of calculated precision and raw aggression. He's known for his late braking maneuvers, often diving into corners with a confidence that borders on reckless. However, beneath the surface lies a meticulous strategist. He's adept at managing tire wear, patiently stalking his prey, and then unleashing a decisive attack when the opportunity arises. His ability to adapt to changing track conditions and extract every last ounce of performance from his Opala makes him a formidable opponent.

rivalries.name: Ricardo Esteves
rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from a controversial collision at the 2022 Taruma Circuit race, where Esteves accused Devitte of deliberately forcing him off the track.

rivalries.name: Isabela Cardoso
rivalries.reason: A fierce competition both on and off the track. Cardoso, another rising star, often challenges Devitte's dominance with her aggressive and tactical race craft.

rivalries.name: Marco Silva
rivalries.reason: Silva, a veteran of the Old Stock series, views Devitte's youthful exuberance as a threat to the established order, resulting in frequent on-track clashes and heated exchanges in the media.

quirks: Always wears the same faded Senna t-shirt under his racing suit.
Listens to a specific samba track before every race to calm his nerves.
Refuses to wash his lucky racing gloves, claiming they hold the key to his victories.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't just about speed; it's about understanding the dance between man and machine. It's about anticipating the next move, like a game of chess at 200 kilometers per hour."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2023 Curitiba Grand Prix after starting from P8, showcasing his incredible overtaking skills and strategic brilliance.
careerLowPoint: Suffering a mechanical failure on the final lap of the 2022 Guaporé race while leading, costing him a virtually guaranteed victory.
